Recipe № 34

Cast-Iron Rosemary Focaccia

Crisp-bottomed, dimpled and rich with olive oil. One 10-inch skillet, four pantry ingredients, and an afternoon of patience.

8
Serves20m
Prep2h
Proof25m
Bake
Ingredients
400 gBread flour320 gWarm water8 gFine salt7 gInstant yeast3 tbspOlive oil + more for the pan2 sprigsRosemaryto finishFlaky salt
Method
1Mix
Whisk flour, salt and yeast. Add the warm water and 2 tbsp oil; stir to a shaggy, sticky dough.2First proof
Cover and leave somewhere warm ~2 h, until doubled and bubbled.3Oil the skillet
Pour 1 tbsp oil into a 10-inch cast-iron skillet; turn the dough into it.4Dimple & rest
Oil your fingers; press deep dimples all over. Rest 20 min while the oven heats.5Finish
Drizzle with oil, tuck in rosemary sprigs, and scatter over flaky salt.6Bake
220°C / 430°F for 25 min, until deep gold. Cool 10 min before cutting.
Notes — from the kitchen
No cast iron? A cake tin works — just add two minutes. The crumb is even better after an overnight cold proof in the fridge.
